name: lesson-courseware
capabilities: Executable LessonPlan / Presentation AST contracts (JSON Schema + Ajv)
Layout Registry as single source of truth (19 layouts incl. declarative composite)
Declarative composite layouts: YAML specs (grid + zones + timeline), no code for new page shapes
Block-type to layout map with unit/subject-level overrides
Unit/lesson policy packs (4th strategy dimension, allowlisted keys)
OpenXML native click fade-in timeline injection
Strategy content packs and quality rule packs (YAML)
Reusable pipeline API (runCoursewareBuild) with CLI adapter

changelog.1.4.0: 可变版面三件套：声明式组合版式 composite（YAML spec 即新页型）、内容块→版式映射（单元/学科覆盖）、单元/课时策略偏好包；金样快照零漂移
changelog.1.3.0: 架构治理：Layout Registry 单一事实源、可执行双 AST 契约、渲染器按版式拆分、策略内容包与质量规则包下沉、CLI 库化与 CI
changelog.1.2.0: 升级分层解耦智能课件引擎，落地一键流水线 build_courseware.js 与语数英三科垂直切片，几何体检 0 Critical 交付
changelog.1.1.0: 增加 OpenXML 原生单击淡入动效与几何审计门禁
changelog.1.0.0: 初始版本：基于五层教材知识库的人教版课件生成
